title: Songify Remake - Django & Spotify API
description:
This project is my own version (a remake) of a web application project I worked on at Fontys.

It lives on AWS and is implemented using Django, it also makes use of Spotify API to fetch categories and statistics with most popular songs of chosen artists.

title: Web Dashboard - DP
description:
A dashboard with a very similar site layout & tools I've used at ASML, but with my own idea.

Of course, the ASML web-dashboard solution was way more rich in features & personalization.

Current version of this dashboard is just a concept with fake data.

title: Mobile App - DP
description:
A mobile interface used for:
- Fetching workout plan.
- Loading exercises per session.
- Taking in session data, and updating database records.

Currently it is still an idea, eventually will be realized and shared here.

title: API - DP
description:
Also part of the 'DP' project, this API will be used to serve formatted data to the dashboard, and serve/save workout data - which will be collected from a mobile interface.

As with Mobile App - DP, this is still an idea.
